CREATE TYPE battery_efficiency_enum AS ENUM ('Low', 'Medium', 'High');

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION classify_battery_efficiency()
RETURNS TABLE (device_id VARCHAR, efficiency_value NUMERIC, efficiency_classification battery_efficiency_enum)
AS $ 
DECLARE
    batt_percentage SMALLINT;
    batt_life NUMERIC;
BEGIN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT 
        t2.devregistry AS device_id,
        (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) AS efficiency_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) < 0.5 THEN 'Low'::battery_efficiency_enum
            WHEN (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) >= 0.5 AND (t1.battlifeh / NULLIF(t1.battlevel, 0)) < 1.0 THEN 'Medium'::battery_efficiency_enum
            ELSE 'High'::battery_efficiency_enum
        END AS efficiency_classification
    FROM 
        testsessions AS t1
    JOIN 
        deviceidentity AS t2 ON t1.sessionregistry = t2.devsessionref
    WHERE 
        t2.conntype IN ('Wireless', 'Bluetooth');
END;
$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
